note: malformed array suffixes such as String[]junk[] were accepted and their dimension computed from length; addition-only regex check throws IllegalArgumentException unless the tail is repeated [] pairs
boxing a primitive to a supertype of its wrapper cost the same as boxing to the wrapper itself, making overload choice ambiguous; addition-only extra penalty inside the existing autoboxing branch

derived quotedNullString not recomputed when setQuote changed the quote character, so its value depended on setter order; rule 6 puts a derived field not refreshed under STATE although the fix is addition-only

range checks like nBools - 1 + dstPos >= Byte.SIZE overflowed in int arithmetic for large arguments, skipping the IllegalArgumentException; each operand widened to long, one fault repeated in 28 methods

repeat computed inputLength * count in unchecked int arithmetic, so overflow surfaced as NegativeArraySizeException or index errors; multiplication replaced by Math.multiplyExact with IllegalArgumentException; abbreviate's added final is cosmetic
normalizeUpperBounds compared bounds with != instead of type equality, so equal but distinct Type instances each eliminated the other; one-token operator substitution

divideBy went through multiplyBy(fraction.invert()), which overflows when the divisor's reciprocal is unrepresentable though the quotient fits; fix replaces it with direct long cross-multiplication and gcd reduction

static invocation could resolve to an instance method and then fail in invoke(null); the candidate test and the method filter gained a static-only clause, plus a static check in invokeExactStaticMethod

primitive-array join overloads never validated startIndex and endIndex, so out-of-range indices with a non-positive count returned empty instead of throwing; addition-only check via a new helper in eight overloads

a null delimiter was passed straight to LangCollectors.joining instead of being mapped to empty; ObjectUtils.toString always transforms the argument, f(x) to f(g(x)) with no condition, so modified rather than preserved
endIndexExclusive was clamped only from above, so a very negative end made end - start overflow to a positive size; max0 wrapping in nine overloads is a transformation, not a preserved guard

for negative durations accept passed truncated toMillis() with non-negative nanos, so the parts did not sum to the duration; original toMillis() kept verbatim as the else-branch of a new isNegative() ternary

annotation equals, hashCode and toString treated synthetic, static or private declared methods as members; the member test gained public, abstract and non-synthetic clauses via a helper, also applied in hashCode; setAccessible made lazy too

hand-written isCreatable scanner disagreed with createNumber on edge cases; fix deletes the whole scanner and delegates to createNumber, catching RuntimeException, replacing the approach rather than extending it

Reader variant of printWithQuotes doubled only quote characters, leaving a configured escape character unescaped inside quotes; the doubling condition gained a c == escape clause and now appends c itself

WeekYear rule called Calendar.getWeekYear() unconditionally, which throws for calendars without week dates such as JapaneseImperialCalendar; original call preserved verbatim inside a new isWeekDateSupported() ternary falling back to YEAR

ISO country, language and numeric-area checks used Unicode-aware predicates (isAllUpperCase, isNumeric, Character.isUpperCase) that accept non-ASCII letters and digits; each swapped for its ASCII-only CharUtils counterpart

recursive style descended into Number subclasses, AtomicBoolean and MutableBoolean, printing their internals; the existing wrapper and String filter, moved into accept(), gained those clauses plus a null check

mutable TimeZone stored and returned by reference in FastDatePrinter and FastDateParser, whose instances are shared through the FastDateFormat cache; defensive clones in constructors and getTimeZone, an ownership fault under rule 6

era text came from DateFormatSymbols.getEras(), Gregorian only, so Buddhist calendars printed wrong names and Japanese Imperial eras threw ArrayIndexOutOfBounds; the TextField is replaced by a new calendar-aware EraField rule

getMatchingAccessibleConstructor's direct lookup returned constructors of non-public classes without an accessibility check; fix adds isAccessible early returns and keeps the original return inside a guard on getAccessibleConstructor's result
escape test pos > offset let an escape character ending a substituted value escape the next variable marker; the condition now compares with escapeStart, a new local advanced past each substitution
hex literals equal to Integer.MIN_VALUE or Long.MIN_VALUE, like -0x80000000, were judged too large and widened; both size conditions gained a && !isNegativeMinimum clause computed by a new local

getAbbreviatedName treated JVM array names like [[Ljava.lang.String; as dotted class names, mangling the encoding; addition-only branch keeps the brackets and abbreviates the element class name recursively

append(Object) registered objects in the shared reflection REGISTRY, so a hashCode() using reflectionHashCode hit the cycle guard and skipped its fields; fix gives append its own thread-local registry, a shared-object fault

month-only patterns like MMMM printed format-form month names where SimpleDateFormat on Java 9+ uses standalone forms; original arrays kept verbatim as ternary else-branches, rest added; L-case edits only reuse a hoisted local
double inclusiveBetween and exclusiveBetween let NaN through because every comparison with NaN is false; the existing out-of-range condition gained a || Double.isNaN(value) clause in four overloads

toLocale rejected every string containing #, so JDK special-case locales th_TH_TH and ja_JP_JP could not round-trip; fix drops that over-restrictive guard and adds two special-case branches, a replaced approach
long-suffixed numbers accepted a leading minus but not a plus, so +123L failed; the sign test numeric.charAt(0) == '-' widened to isSign(), giving the condition its missing '+' alternative

case-insensitive replace lowercased searchString before a case-insensitive search, so length-changing lowercase forms broke matching and the replaced span; fix deletes the redundant lowercasing, a removal-only change of approach

clone resolved proxy classes by interface name through the default loader, failing or picking another loader's same-named interfaces; fix records the original proxy classes when serialising and reuses them (serialisation, identity)

sleepQuietly swallowed InterruptedException without restoring the thread's interrupt status, losing the interruption for callers; addition-only re-interrupt in the catch, read as a concurrency fault under STATE rather than OMISSION
